novelty_flags.label: prop:sharp-lower-endpoint
novelty_flags.one_line: The conditional-coupling sharp lower endpoint is already the causal-COT partial-identification principle in ji2024modelagnostic and lin2026statistical; retain it as setup rather than a novelty-bearing proposition.

novelty_flags.label: lem:randomized-sanity-check
novelty_flags.one_line: This is direct substitution of pi=1/2 and only recovers the randomized score algebra already underlying lin2026statistical; it is an implementation check, not a novel result.

novelty_flags.label: related_work / thm:observed-gradient / thm:uniform-one-step
novelty_flags.one_line: Add the closer omitted COT papers lin2025tightening (ICML 2025 relaxation and rate) and lin2025estimation (arXiv:2506.00257 direct consistent COT estimator), and delimit their target, sampling regime, and guarantee against the proposed observed-law EIF.

soundness_flags.label: def:learner-regime / thm:uniform-one-step
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed second-order remainder is not implied by the stated separate L2 rates: arbitrary Vhat and phihat satisfying them can have a first-order conditional mean error, since no foldwise centering or coupled orthogonality condition ties Vhat, phihat, and qhat to the transport plug-in.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:uniform-one-step / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Accept fixed overlap, smooth arm kernels, and sigma_n>=sigma_star as a regular-regime restriction; equality and vanishing-variance sequences are excluded.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The efficiency, studentized normality, and Wald-coverage claims are conditional on the fixed-overlap, smooth, variance-separated observed-law class; the equality frontier is reserved for oeq:degeneracy-adaptive-inference.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Specify a foldwise centered transport plug-in construction, such as defining Vhat and phihat from the same qhat and imposing the exact conditional bias/orthogonality identity that yields the displayed product remainder; then derive rather than assume the variance rate.

Add lin2025tightening and lin2025estimation to related work and state a sharp comparison table separating relaxed/direct COT estimation, randomized smooth-COT inference, and the proposed observational primal-EIF target.
Turn the degeneracy handle into a named local perturbation family and a concrete candidate second-order statistic or resampling functional, so its normalization target is falsifiable.

recommended_next_step: Revise the one-step learner construction to make its bias cancellation and remainder derivable, expand the COT prior-art comparison, then rerun the field-tier novelty review.
